preserved_source: Recovered from 1bc082f876f3005ec3cca69e844d4e2a3f29262b: typed GlobalState member address &root->state in both switch arms.

experiment.hypothesis: Declare the embedded State as a one-element array and obtain both root prefix and State pointers through array-to-pointer decay; older MWCC may preserve decay address calculations that it folds for explicit casts and direct member addresses.
experiment.source_variant: GlobalState.state changed from State to State[1]; lbl_8064C8D4 assigned from root->pad0 decay; state assigned from root->state decay; linked-buffer value spelled base+0x7B8.
experiment.result: Rejected and not retained. Array decay was folded to the same flat root-relative stores; it did not emit retail addi r3,r31,0 or addi r5,r31,0x654. Default-arm instruction order was addi r0,r31,0x7b8 then addi r3,r31,0x654 and the store remained 0x7b0(r31).

relocation_strict.objdiff_command: build/tools/objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_8006B21C fn_8006B21C -o reports/GEDE01/objdiff-7c9a7c78-f444-490c-a897-a9d084b1655c-reloc-strict.json --format json -c function_reloc_diffs=name_address
relocation_strict.comparison: cmp canonical strict: exit 0 (byte-identical raw reports)

remaining_divergence: Generated output is 320 bytes versus 328 retail. GC/1.3 omits retail addi r3,r31,0 before the lbl_8064C8D4 store and addi r5,r31,0x654 before the four State field stores, folding both into r31-relative operations. In the default arm it forms the linked value as addi r0,r3,0x164 and stores to 0x7b0(r31), versus retail addi r0,r31,0x7b8 and stw r0,0x15c(r3).
